name: claude-trading-skills
tagline_zh: 散户看盘像开盲盒？这套技能把行情、日历、选股器焊进 Claude Code，连 K 线形态都帮你画好。
tagline_en: Stop trading blind. This skill pack wires live markets, econ calendars, screeners, and chart patterns into Claude.
desc_en: Claude Code skills for equity investors and traders — market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners, and trading strategy development.
why_zh: 同类多是单点工具，它是一整套交易工作流，从数据到策略闭环，且每个技能都带 CLI 接口，可自由组合。
why_en: Unlike scattered single-purpose tools, this is a full trading workflow—data to strategy—with CLI-friendly skills that chain.
